name: next-router-example
description: Next.js App Router conventions running on Sparkling native navigation via sparkling-next-router

scripts.prebuild:web: pnpm -C ../.. --filter sparkling-method --filter sparkling-navigation --filter sparkling-storage --filter sparkling-media --filter sparkling-history-shim build
scripts.build:web: pnpm run prebuild:web && rspeedy build --environment web
scripts.dev:web: pnpm run build:web && LYNX_BUNDLE_DIR=./dist/web pnpm --filter sparkling-web-shell dev
